items.title: Why L3Harris Technologies Stock Is Plummeting Today
items.summary: L3Harris just posted a great quarterly report, but the market is reacting negatively to IPO-related news.

items.title: Missiles Are Hot. That’s Good for Lockheed Martin Stock.
items.summary: The U.S. has fired a lot of missiles lately, leaving the Defense Department motivated to quickly replace and grow its missile stocks.  “When you add the $54 billion dollars in this contract modification, you’re pushing $300 billion dollars of backlog for the company,” said CEO Jim Taiclet on Fox Business.  Lockheed is tripling production of its PAC-3 missiles.

items.title: L3Harris Missile Business Is Booming. So Why Is the Stock Tanking?
items.summary: The defense contractor reported second-quarter earnings per share of $3.13. Wall Street was looking for $2.80.

items.title: L3Harris (LHX) Q2 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates

items.title: L3Harris (LHX) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: L3Harris (LHX) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +11.79% and +1.50%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: L3Harris Raises Guidance on Higher Profit, Revenue
items.summary: The defense contractor said it now expects full-year earnings between $11.80 and $12.00 a share, up 40 cents from the company’s previous guidance.
